blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Juan Miguel Zubiri dared Agriculture Sec. Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. to crack down on pork price manipulators, smugglers and excessive meat imports amid struggling hog raisers and falling farm gate prices that continue to affect consumers. Zubiri issued his challenge to the Department of Agriculture (DA) chief during a Senate hearing on the department’s proposed budget on Wednesday. READ: DA backs ‘phased’ pork tariff hikes “Ilabas mo yung galit mo sa mga predatory pricing, pati yung mga smugglers. Labanan mo, huwag ka matakot,” Zubiri told Tiu Laurel.
